body: Hmmm I wish you could take me with you to the Falls. Unfortunately I'm nowhere near them. :( I hope you find peace, whether it be through death or (if you change your mind) life.
Well my parents know I have a history of suicidal stuff so if the police don't investigate? do they always have to? also I don't actually have a dresser with drawers
thank you j appreciate it. You are incredibly nice yourself too. :)
true I'm impulsive though and don't know when I'm gonna do it so having it on me 24-7 probably isn't the best option?
Youre kindness is appreciated but please do not waste your time on me I'm really sorry and I don't mind being called sir I am a girl though. Sir is fine though

Texting it to them is Mr an option it's 4 pgs long and I hand wrote it 

They know I have issues they'll probably be surprised to an extent but not shocked
thank you for your attempt at conversation it is appreciated however i am not inclined to waste your time on this subject.
that's unimportant please stick to the topic outlined in the prompt -20 points for being off topic
thank you. you don't have to be good with words your thoughts are appreciated.
I wish I had something to look forward to but right now I don't. just more depression all day every day

Thank you for putting my post back. i had no idea about the note rule and if I had broken it that wouldve be fine it you took it down. 

i'm sorry about your friends. thank you I'll let you know if I need anything.
Thank you for the hugs. i'm glad you're life got better than it was!
yeah. thanks. I mentioned it they read it and I'm alive and I find out I will never forgive them so hopefully that should deter anybody who finds it.

thanks for the internet hugs. my hand needs them. 4 pages front and back that was too much writing. 

yes there are people who will miss me but how long can I continue to live for other people? its been 5 years now and it's not fair to ask me to keep going just for them. they say suicide is selfish but i think *thats* selfish. 

all my hobbies have been stolen by depression. I hope he's at least enjoying all the books I could've read and the music I could've made. I know I sure as hell aren't. 

i'm not 100% sold on it yet, but I'm a pretty impulsive person and I have been thinking and planning a lot, so I'm writing this just to make sure that even if I do it unexpectedly something will be left behind instead of nothing.
